Rental Market Analysis Report

Market research report on comparable rental rates in your location, property type, and tenure — data-driven positioning for confident rent-setting.

Why You Need This Service

The housing market changes constantly. What you charged 2 years ago may no longer be competitive. Setting rent without knowing the market means:

  • Too low: You leave thousands in cedis on the table
  • Too high: No tenants apply, your unit sits vacant
  • No justification: Tenant challenges rent at Rent Control with no market data to counter
  • Guessing: You're competing with neighbors but don't know their rates

This report gives you market data to set rent confidently and defensibly.

What's in the Report

  • Market Overview: Current rental rates in your location and property type
  • Comparable Properties: Details on 8–12 similar properties in your area with their rents
  • Price Range Analysis: Low, median, high rents for your property type
  • Amenity Pricing: How much each amenity (parking, water, DSTV) adds to market rent
  • Your Property Positioning: Where your property fits in the market
  • Recommended Rent Range: Evidence-based rent recommendation
  • Market Trends: Are rents rising or falling in your area?
  • Defensibility: Documentation you can show to tenant or Rent Control

How We Research

  • Active listings on rental platforms (Jumia, Whatsapp, local agents)
  • Recently rented properties in your area
  • Real estate agent insights from your neighborhood
  • Published market reports for Ghana
  • Property type and location-specific analysis

When You Need This Service

  • You're setting rent on a new property and want to position it correctly
  • You're increasing rent and want market justification
  • You suspect your current rent is too low
  • A tenant is challenging your rent and you need comparable data
  • You're buying an investment property and want to know its rental potential
  • You have multiple properties and want pricing consistency across them

The Real Value

If your market rent is GHS 50 higher per month than you're currently charging, a report at GHS 500–1,000 pays for itself in a single month of increased rent. Over a year, it's the difference between GHS 600 in report cost and thousands in additional income.
